mandatory_legal_checks: A&C Act 1996 S.21 — proceedings commence when the request is RECEIVED; the notice must unambiguously invoke arbitration, not merely mention the clause
A&C Act 1996 S.43(2) — commencement under S.21 is what stops limitation running; preserve proof of service
A&C Act 1996 S.7 — the arbitration agreement must be in writing; where incorporated by reference, the reference must be specific enough to carry the clause
A&C Act 1996 S.12 and the Seventh Schedule — a person falling within the Schedule is INELIGIBLE; a clause naming a party's own officer as arbitrator will not survive
A&C Act 1996 S.11(4) and (5) — thirty days from the request before a court appointment may be sought
The Arbitration and Conciliation (Amendment) Bill 2024 is a consultation draft only and is NOT law; the 1996 Act as amended to 2021 governs
